title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2>Information about the position </h2> <p>You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. </p> <p>You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.</p> <h2>As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll: </h2> <ul> <li>Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.</li> <li>Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.</li> <li>Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.</li> <li>Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes</li> <li>Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.</li> <li>Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.</li> </ul> <h2>About you </h2> <ul> <li>Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).</li> <li>Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.</li> <li>Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.</li> <li>Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.</li> <li>Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.</li> <li>Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Fluent in English, both written and spoken</li> <li>Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.</li> <li>Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy [[DELETE IF NOT RELEVANT]] </strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€74.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€100.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.</p> <p>At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  </p> <p>Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  </p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>If you're passionate about quality and continuous improvement, this role offers the opportunity to ensure the effectiveness of training programs, materials and delivery methods, while organisational skills.</li> <li>Fluent in English.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A recognised Assessor qualification.</li> <li>A qualified Vehicle Safety Operator with a title: Emergency Services Liaison, Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.</p> <p>The Emergency Services Liaison - Outreach Teams are integral to ensuring that in any Waymo market, local responders have a good working knowledge of the vehicles and in-built technology, and also have the confidence to safely and effectively interact with the vehicles and riders at any operational incident.</p> <p><em>In this role you will be hybrid based in Munich and report into our Head of Enterprise Resilience</em>.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive strategic engagement and cultivate long-term trust with German emergency services by positioning Waymo as a transparent, collaborative partner committed to their safety.</li> <li>Direct the recruitment and training of Emergency Services Ambassadors (ESAs) to serve as local advocates, acting as the definitive subject matter expert for all responder-related inquiries.</li> <li>Spearhead the implementation and continuous improvement of Waymo’s German Emergency Services Familiarization Program by benchmarking global best practices and ensuring responders remain confident in their ability to interact safely with Waymo technology.</li> <li>Serve as the voice of Waymo at industry events and panels, influencing by bridging the gap between Emergency Services and AV technology.</li> <li>Architect robust Emergency Services communication that captures and channels critical feedback directly into our engineering teams, driving continuous product improvements around Emergency Services.</li> <li>Orchestrate internal alignment by translating responder insights into actionable strategic improvements, ensuring our engineering and operations teams are always responsive to the evolving realities of Emergency Services.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of service in German emergency services (Polizei, Feuerwehr, or Rettungsdienst)</li> <li>Deep understanding of German legal frameworks (Datenschutz/GDPR, Rettungskette), emergency protocols, and community engagement strategies</li> <li>Proven experience in emergency response and building relationships with Emergency Services organisations such as the Berliner Feuerwehr and Polizei Berlin, along with a  strong understanding of the specific nuances and sensitivities of Emergency Services communities  in Germany.</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, in both German and English, capable of engaging diverse audiences, combined with an ability  to lead, motivate and develop teams, constantly striving for excellence across all areas.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with legal and other internal teams, combined with experience of being able to  stay focused and deliver under competing pressures, whilst ensuring that programs remain on track and deadline targets are consistently met.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 7 years in a leadership or management position within one of Germany's principal emergency services, with a proven record of collaborative  inter-agency working, and the ability to engage with strategic, tactical and operational teams as required</li> <li>Experience establishing organisational presence in new geographic locations, operating in rapidly scaling and complex operational environments</li> <li>Familiarity with autonomous vehicle technology and its implications for emergency services.</li> <li>A track record of policy development related to emergency management.</li> <li>Experience in a role requiring significant public speaking and stakeholder engagement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel: </strong></p> <ul> <li>~20% travel (Domestic & International)</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Junior) HR Manager (m/w/d) als Elternzeitvertretung
description: Deine Leidenschaft ist das Personalwesen und du liebst es, Menschen vom ersten Kontakt bis in den Arbeitsalltag hinein zu begleiten? Du hast Lust auf Abwechslung pur – zwischen aktiver Personalsuche, persönlicher Mitarbeiterbetreuung und strukturierter HR-Administration ? Dich zeichnen Organisationsgeschick, Kommunikationsstärke und ein echtes Serviceverständnis für unsere Teams aus? Dann bist du bei uns goldrichtig! Kreuzfahrtberater ist eines der führenden Online-Portale für die Vermittlung von Kreuzfahrten aller namhaften Reedereien im DACH-Raum. Wir sind stolz auf unsere nachgewiesene Service-Qualität (Trust-Pilot: 4,8) sowie wiederholte Auszeichnungen als bestes Kreuzfahrtportal Deutschlands. Für unser HR-Team suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten (Junior) HR Manager (m/w/d) . Die Position ist im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung bis Sommer 2028 befristet. Wir arbeiten hybrid: Dein Hauptstandort ist dabei in Ahrensburg, gleichzeitig freuen wir uns auf deine regelmäßige Präsenz in unserem Hamburger Büro für den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Teams. Aufgaben Das erklärte Ziel: Unsere Mitarbeitenden und Bewerbenden als fester Anker im HR-Alltag begleiten und mit einer ganzheitlichen operativen HR-Betreuung entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles stets für den passenden Rückenwind sorgen. Dabei sind deine Kernaufgaben: Selbstständige Steuerung des Bewerbungsprozesses für ausgewählte Vakanzen - vom Verfassen und Schalten der Stellenanzeigen über die Sichtung der Unterlagen bis hin zur Betreuung der Bewerbenden und der Durchführung von Auswahlterminen (Telefoninterviews, Videocalls, Bewerbertage, Probearbeiten) Empathische Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen (persönlich vor Ort an den Standorten Ahrensburg und Hamburg, per E-Mail und Telefon) Verlässliche Begleitung des gesamten On- und Offboarding-Prozesses Aktive Teilnahme an Feedback- und Mitarbeitergesprächen Sorgfältige Durchführung aller administrativen HR-Aufgaben (z.B. Erstellung von Arbeitszeugnissen, Abruf von eAUs und A1-Bescheinigungen), Pflege unseres Personalmanagementsystems sowie Erstellung relevanter Auswertungen Vorbereitende Lohnbuchhaltung / Schnittstelle zu unserem externen Steuerbüro für die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung Administrative Unterstützung im Office Management (z.B. Nachbestellung von Büromaterial, Terminkoordination für Dienstleister) sowie tatkräftige Unterstützung bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer Firmenveranstaltungen Qualifikation Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich Personalmanagement, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet abgeschlossen – alternativ bringst du erste relevante Berufserfahrung im Personalwesen mit. Du verfügst über erste praktische Einblicke im operativen Personalmanagement, in der HR-Administration oder konntest bereits Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in sammeln. Du bist ein echtes Kommunikationstalent mit ausgeprägter Serviceorientierung, trittst auf allen Ebenen souverän auf und hast große Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Menschen und Abteilungen. Der gewissenhafte und absolut vertrauenswürdige Umgang mit sensiblen Daten ist für dich selbstverständlich. Deine Aufgaben gehst du mit einer klaren Hands-on-Mentalität an: Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und treibst Themen pragmatisch und eigeninitiativ voran. Im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist du vollkommen sattelfest und du kommunizierst sehr gut in Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch. Genau wie wir begeisterst du dich für die Touristik – erste Einblicke in die Reise- oder Kreuzfahrtbranche sind ein tolles Extra, aber kein Muss. Erste Grundkenntnisse im Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht sind von Vorteil, aber kein Must-have – was dir an Praxiswissen noch fehlt, arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Team auf. Benefits Neben den besten Kolleginnen und Kollegen der Welt wartet u.a. auf dich: Befristete Anstellung bis Sommer 2028 im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Wechsel von Büropräsenz und Homeoffice 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr bei einer 5-Tage-Woche Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge über das gesetzliche Maß hinaus Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket oder zum PKW-Stellplatz in unserer Tiefgarage in Ahrensburg Vergünstigter Zugang zu "EGYM Wellpass" (Fitness & Wellness) Teambudget für gemeinsame Events Vergünstigte Kreuzfahrten für dich und deine Familie sowie weitere Touristikervorteile Teilnahme an Schiffsbesichtigungen und Veranstaltungen unserer Reedereipartner Perfekte Lebensläufe gibt es selten – und wir suchen keine Superhelden. Für uns zählen vor allem deine Motivation, deine Persönlichkeit und dein Potenzial. Alles Weitere können wir gemeinsam entwickeln. Bewirb’ dich daher gern, auch wenn nicht alle aufgeführten Anforderungen passen – wir schauen lieber gemeinsam, ob der Kurs stimmt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Vous veillez à ce que le profil de risque de l’entreprise soit correctement identifié, évalué, suivi et communiqué, tout en contribuant au renforcement de son environnement de contrôle et de sa culture du risque. Vous managez une équipe de deux personnes et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le CEO, la Direction générale, les fonctions de contrôle et les équipes opérationnelles. En tant que véritable business partner, vous accompagnez l’entreprise dans ses prises de décision, tout en vous assurant que ses activités restent conformes aux exigences réglementaires applicables, aux politiques internes et à l’appétit au risque défini. Il s’agit d’un poste stratégique et opérationnel, particulièrement adapté à une personne qui apprécie de construire et d’améliorer des dispositifs dans un environnement international, en forte évolution et réglementé. Les principales responsabilités : Contrôle interne et contrôle permanent Piloter et améliorer en continu le dispositif de contrôle interne de niveaux 1 et 2. Définir, maintenir et mettre en œuvre le plan annuel de contrôle permanent. Veiller à ce que les contrôles soient correctement conçus, documentés, réalisés et justifiés. Développer les indicateurs de contrôle pertinents et les reportings destinés à la Direction et aux instances de gouvernance. Identifier les faiblesses du dispositif de contrôle, évaluer leur impact et coordonner les actions correctives. Promouvoir une culture forte du contrôle et de la gestion des risques dans l’ensemble de l’organisation. Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’optimisation des outils et processus de type GRC. Risques opérationnels et gestion des risques Piloter le dispositif de gestion des risques opérationnels, notamment l’identification, l’évaluation et le suivi des risques. Coordonner la préparation et la mise à jour régulière des cartographies des risques de l’entreprise. Organiser et maintenir le Risk Appetite Framework, ainsi que le suivi des indicateurs d’appétit au risque. Piloter le processus de gestion et de reporting des incidents, en veillant à ce que les incidents soient enregistrés, analysés et suivis de manière appropriée. Suivre les risques opérationnels, non financiers et émergents, notamment les risques liés à la technologie, à la cybersécurité, à la fraude, à l’externalisation et aux processus métiers. Préparer des reportings risques clairs et exploitables à destination de la Direction générale et des instances de gouvernance concernées. Gouvernance et comités Préparer, coordonner et animer le Comité des risques trimestriel. Accompagner le Chief Compliance & Risk Officer et la Direction générale dans leurs prises de décision liées aux risques. Préparer les supports de gouvernance, tableaux de bord et présentations offrant une vision claire de l’environnement de risques et de contrôle de l’entreprise. Coordonner la définition et la mise à jour des rôles et responsabilités, notamment au travers des matrices RACI. Contribuer aux processus de reporting réglementaire et interne, notamment au rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne, ainsi qu’aux autres reportings réglementaires applicables. Audits et contrôles réglementaires Coordonner les audits externes, réglementaires et internes portant sur le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels et la gouvernance. Être le point de contact principal des auditeurs et des autorités compétentes sur les sujets de contrôle interne. Gérer les demandes d’audit, la collecte des éléments justificatifs, le suivi des constats et les actions associées. Coordonner la préparation et la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions correctifs et préventifs. Suivre l’avancement des plans de remédiation et présenter les actions à risque élevé ou en retard aux instances de gouvernance appropriées. Coordonner le programme de contrôle périodique et suivre sa mise en œuvre conformément au plan d’audit défini. Externalisation, continuité d’activité et résilience opérationnelle Garantir la robustesse et la bonne exécution du dispositif PSEE. Contribuer au pilotage des activités externalisées et des prestataires tiers, conformément aux exigences réglementaires applicables. Piloter les activités de continuité d’activité et de résilience opérationnelle de l’entreprise. Maintenir et tester régulièrement les plans de continuité d’activité. Participer aux exercices et aux réunions de gestion de crise lorsque cela est nécessaire. Identifier les opportunités permettant de renforcer la résilience de Lemonway et sa capacité à maintenir ses activités critiques en cas de perturbation. Politiques, procédures et formation Évaluer les besoins de création ou de mise à jour des politiques, procédures, formulaires et documents de contrôle. Coordonner la rédaction, la revue et la mise en œuvre des procédures de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques. Concevoir ou contribuer à la création de supports de formation et de sensibilisation. Veiller à ce que la documentation soit claire, opérationnelle, à jour et alignée avec le modèle de fonctionnement de l’entreprise. Expérience Vous disposez d’au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans le contrôle interne, les risques opérationnels, l’ERM, l’audit, la conformité ou un domaine proche. Vous avez évolué dans un environnement réglementé, idéalement dans le secteur du paiement ou en fintech. Vous avez déjà encadré une équipe et travaillé sur la structuration ou la transformation d’un dispositif de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne. Compétences recherchées Solide connaissance des dispositifs de contrôle interne et de gestion des risques opérationnels. Bonne compréhension de l’environnement réglementaire français et européen, notamment des attentes de l’ACPR, des orientations de l’EBA, des exigences LCB-FT et de la DSP2. Expérience du fonctionnement d’instances de gouvernance et de la préparation de reportings destinés à la Direction générale. Maîtrise des environnements de transformation, de croissance ou de scale-up. Expérience de la mise en place ou de l’évolution d’outils GRC. Très bon niveau de français et d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. La connaissance de l’allemand ou d’une autre langue européenne constitue un atout. Qualités personnelles Leadership affirmé et bonnes compétences managériales. Esprit structuré, rigoureux et grande capacité d’organisation. Autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collaboratif. Approche pragmatique, orientée solutions et résultats. Solides capacités d’analyse et grande attention aux détails. Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes. Capacité à challenger de manière constructive et à convaincre des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux. title: Principal Statistical Programmer /Analyst Consultant -CVRM
description: <p> </p> <p>Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….</p> <p>ClinChoice is searching for a <strong>Principal Statistical Programmer Consultant</strong> to join one of our clients.</p> <p>ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO with a strong focus on quality, professional development, and supportive culture. As a client-facing role, we are looking for confident candidates with the ability to work independently whilst establishing a high-trust environment with the client’s counterparts.  <br><br></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities: </strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li data-section-id="u5fb48" data-start="362" data-end="426">Leading statistical programming activities for clinical trials</li> <li data-section-id="clpryt" data-start="427" data-end="507">Developing/reviewing <strong data-start="450" data-end="466">SAS programs</strong>, datasets, tables, listings, and figures</li> <li data-section-id="1oswcm" data-start="508" data-end="565">Providing technical guidance to Statistical Programmers</li> <li data-section-id="1uh9d4y" data-start="566" data-end="616">Reviewing programming specifications and outputs</li> <li data-section-id="14zjwcn" data-start="617" data-end="670">Supporting <strong data-start="630" data-end="643">SDTM/ADaM</strong> and regulatory submissions</li> <li data-section-id="z5918x" data-start="671" data-end="742">Working closely with statisticians, data managers, and clinical teams</li> <li data-section-id="inrtp6" data-start="743" data-end="803">Taking ownership of programming deliverables and timelines</li> <li data-section-id="6e50m0" data-start="804" data-end="845">Mentoring junior and senior programmers</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Education and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science (CS), statistics, or related scientific disciplines with 5 yrs. of clinical programming (CDISC) experience; Master’s degree in CS, statistics or related disciplines with 6 yrs. of clinical programming (CDISC) experience.</li> <li>Working knowledge of ICH and Good Clinical Practices, Clinical research, Clinical trial process, and related regulatory requirements and terminology.</li> <li>Good understanding of the clinical drug development process.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and coordination skills.</li> <li>Current knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements relevant for the role</li> <li>Ability to proactively manage concurrent activities within a project</li> <li>Proficient ability to influence relevant stakeholders on programming-related items</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Application Process</strong></p> <p>Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.  Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.</p> <p><strong>Who will you be working for?</strong></p> <p><strong>About ClinChoice</strong></p> <p>ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.           </p> <p><strong>Our Company Ethos</strong></p> <p>Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.</p> <p>ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.</p> <p><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak"><strong><br><span data-teams="true">#LI-DNP</span></strong></span></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Senior Systems Engineers with broad experience to drive the delivery a variety of software enabled hardware capabilities to our customers. Anduril Senior Systems Engineers rapidly develop expertise in new domains in order to architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation capabilities through the entire product life-cycle.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO</h3> <ul> <li>Own technology solutions that are deployed to customers, focussed on the delivery of value to the end-user</li> <li>Act as a subject matter expert for your areas of expertise as they relate to the delivery of Anduril’s technology capabilities, including areas such as hardware selection and integration, testing and evaluation, robotic perception, engineering process or cybersecurity</li> <li>Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment</li> <li>Design, architect, and implement integrated systems, including advanced and sensitive platforms and payloads, that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current systems, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time</li> <li>Contribute to the design and development of technology components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines</li> <li>Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of complex robotic systems, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation.</li> <li>Support vehicle and payload manufacturing, testing and deployment</li> <li>Travel to co-locate with end-users up to 20% of the time</li> <li>Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for Engineers from differing backgrounds</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Extensive professional experience working as an Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise</li> <li>Ability to exercise extremely high ownership over a complex system, including design, integration, test, and delivery of new capabilities</li> <li>Capacity to work holistically on complex robotic systems across design, implementation, operation and sustainment</li> <li>Capacity to act as the technical owner for a complex subsystem, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution</li> <li>Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance</li> </ul> <h3>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and support of robotic and/or autonomous systems</li> <li>Experience working within the defence, maritime and/or aerospace domains</li> <li>Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment</li> <li>Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Systems Engineer, such as Principal Systems Engineer and/or Engineering Manager</li> <li>Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery</li> </ul> <p>Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. </span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p> </p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.</p> </div> <div class="RichText column2"> <p class="detailElios">To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:</p> <ul> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>No Financial Requests: </strong>Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. title: Senior Quality Systems Engineer, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Quality Systems Engineer to join our London team and help develop future opportunities for our internal quality management system and digitization efforts. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge Quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success.<br>We are growing and this role will focus on internal site growth and implementing a world-class quality management system, supporting our internal manufacturing sites, supplier sites, and allied facilities. This role carries responsibility for ensuring compliance with UK and European regulatory frameworks, NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace, and UK Ministry of Defense (MOD) requirements as part of our London operations.<br>The right person for this role has extensive knowledge in Quality Management System (QMS) systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement to help shape our internal systems, tools, procedures and the culture of quality at Anduril. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, help others succeed on the quality journey, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.</p> <h3><strong>About the Job</strong></h3> <p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a real time, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS and its top-level processes. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete internal and external audits of the QMS.</li> <li>Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS software implementation and adoption across Anduril sites, including the London facility. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete implementation, internal and external audits of the QMS.</li> <li>Ensure full compliance with UK regulatory requirements, including UK MOD Defense Standards (DEF STANs), UKCA marking where applicable, and relevant UK Health & Safety Executive (HSE) regulations for defense manufacturing environments.</li> <li>Drive compliance with NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107 (Mutual Acceptance of Government Quality Assurance and Usage of the Allied Quality Assurance Publications), STANAG 4159 (NATO Quality Assurance Requirements for Design, Development and Production — AQAP-2110), and STANAG 4161 (NATO Quality Management System Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense — AQAP-2310).</li> <li>Ensure conformance to STANAG 4404 and associated AQAPs for software-intensive aerospace systems, including AQAP-2210 (NATO Supplementary Software Quality Assurance Requirements) as applicable to Lattice OS and embedded mission systems.</li> <li>Support implementation of STANAG 4685 (Airworthiness) requirements as they relate to quality assurance processes for unmanned aerial systems and aerospace components.</li> <li>Liaise with the UK MOD Quality Assurance representatives, the Defence Quality Assurance (DQA) organisation, and NATO Quality Assurance authorities to support Government Quality Assurance (GQA) activities and audits.</li> <li>Partner with business systems team, product quality engineers and manufacturing engineers to help prepare new processes, digital tools, and sites to meet QMS requirements, develop new capabilities to meet existing QMS requirements and conduct internal audits before manufacturing readiness review and production readiness review.</li> <li>Develop our internal QMS road map for tools and capabilities to match the scaling of the company: to meet customer needs, to enable quality capabilities for new products, and scale quality processes as we grow — with particular attention to UK Export Control and ITAR/EAR interface requirements.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with UK data protection requirements (UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018) as they relate to quality records, supplier data, and audit documentation.</li> <li>Become a systems expert for Anduril’s quality tools, processes, and data sets to enable effective QMS execution across both US and UK operations.</li> <li>Communicate with external audit agencies, including UKAS-accredited certification bodies and NATO quality assurance authorities. Support customer audits as necessary.</li> <li>Manage the QMS internal audit program and lead internal audits.</li> <li>Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities that benefit the QMS and product quality, aligned with AS9100, NATO AQAP, and STANAG frameworks.</li> <li>Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organisation level.</li> <li>Support developing QMS training modules and packages, including UK/NATO-specific regulatory and STANAG training. Facilitate training records and retention with manager of affected trainees.</li> <li>Drive root cause analysis and corrective action with internal findings from audits and customer visits, including UK MOD and NATO audit findings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in aerospace and/or defence manufacturing.</li> <li>Expert knowledge of QMS requirements and auditing in a complex product environment, in one or more of the following QMS standards: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, AS9110C, AS9120B, AS6500, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 13485:2016, TL 9000 R6.3.</li> <li>Demonstrable knowledge of NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107, STANAG 4159, STANAG 4161, and their associated Allied Quality Assurance Publications (AQAPs): AQAP-2110, AQAP-2210, and AQAP-2310.</li> <li>Familiarity with UK MOD Defence Standards (DEF STANs) and Government Quality Assurance (GQA) processes.</li> <li>Understanding of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to defence manufacturing, including UK Export Control Act 2002, HSE regulations, and UKCA/CE marking requirements.</li> <li>Working knowledge with QMS software solutions which might include Net Inspect, Siemens, SAP, ETQ, One Factory, MasterControl, Compliance Quest, Hexagon, PTC, QT9.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms, reporting tools, and basic data visualisation.</li> <li>Demonstrated project management for software system implementation and onboarding suppliers (external users) and internal users.</li> <li>Working knowledge of design, development, manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, contracts, and other organisations that are part of a company-wide audit.</li> <li>Knowledge title: Senior Quantum Scientist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based at our Oxford, UK office with the option to work a few days a week remotely.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Up to 5%<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1777</p> <p><strong>The Role: </strong></p> <p>We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilizing trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology. We approach quantum computing with a focus on minimizing errors, striving to achieve ultra-low gate errors at scale. Our immediate objective is to develop functional quantum computers within the NISQ regime, aiming to construct fault-tolerant machines that require minimal QEC overhead. Our recent breakthroughs include achieving 99.97% fidelity in two-qubit gates and 99.9992% fidelity in single-qubit operations without error correction, setting new industry standards for performance.</p> <p>We are looking for Quantum Scientist to join our UK Science team at IonQ. Our Quantum Scientists work at the forefront of our research efforts to develop the next generation of quantum computers. </p> <p>They are responsible for validating and optimising the performance of our computers, playing a critical role in ensuring we are able to meet our research and development goals and timelines. Our Scientists’ work spans a broad range of areas from designing, coding, debugging and executing experiments, to developing and validating novel control schemes. They are responsible for documenting and sharing their findings with the aim of pushing the boundaries of system performance.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Quantum Scientist, you will typically be responsible for a combination of these different responsibilities:</p> <ul> <li>Prototyping and characterising coherent control and cooling schemes for trapped-ion qubits using laser and microwave fields.</li> <li>Calibrating and benchmarking quantum systems, focusing on achieving the highest fidelities for quantum circuit primitives (e.g. ion transport or gate operations) and full circuits.</li> <li>Validating emerging trap technologies, including integrated electronics and photonics for large-scale architectures.</li> <li>Analysing experimental data, debug complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure reliability of qubit operations.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>To be successful in this role, you will need a PhD in physics or a related discipline, with a strong foundation in atomic or qubit-related physics. Prior postdoctoral or industry experience is valuable, but we are open to applicants moving directly from a PhD.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone with a solid background in quantum control, and hands-on experience in calibration, benchmarking, or coherent control of qubits, would be desirable. We’re looking for motivated scientists who can contribute to the progress of this fast moving, highly technical team and help the organisation meet our research goals.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Proven expertise in experimental AMO physics or quantum computing. Experience with trapped ions is beneficial though not essential.</li> <li>Prior experience in one or more of the following: spectroscopy or coherent control of multi-level systems, characterisation of control hardware, gate fidelity benchmarking or running quantum circuits on hardware.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in programming and data analysis, experience of Python or Rust is desirable.</li> <li>Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a fast-moving team.</li> <li>A track record of scientific communication through publications, talks and conferences would be advantageous.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.</p> <p>We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.</p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Android Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineer III</a>💰 £85,000 - £110,000 base salary per year ➕ share options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"> Technology</a> </p> <p><strong>About our Mobile Engineering discipline</strong></p> <p><strong>Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds</strong></p> <p>There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.</p> <p> <strong>Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</p> <h2><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></h2> <p>We’re searching for <strong>product-focused Android engineers</strong> to evolve our native mobile app.<strong> </strong>You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. </p> <p>You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 15 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.</p> <p>As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.</p> <p>You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both <em>what</em> we build, and <em>how</em> we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.</p> <p>Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.</p> <p>You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.</p> <h3>Our Android app</h3> <p>Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.</p> <p>Around 95% of the codebase is in Compose. We use Coroutines, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We are currently migrating to Kotlinx Serialisation and Metro. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. </p> <p>We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.</p> <p>We’ve previously written about <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2019/02/11/building-monzo-chat-on-android">building Monzo Chat</a> on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.</p> <h2>You should apply if</h2> <ul> <li>You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output</li> <li>You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin</li> <li>You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You love turning excellent design into beautiful products</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>You have an understanding computer science principles</li> </ul> <h3>The Interview Process</h3> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>There’s a detailed blog on <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/22/preparing-for-mobile-interviews-at-monzo">the interview process</a>, for extra details, hints and tips.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <h2>What’s in it for you</h2> <p>💰 £78,000 - £110,000 base salary per year ➕ plus stock options +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a>, we also provide all of our engineers with the latest MacBook Pro.</p> <p>✈️We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="description content"> <p>Thoughtworks partners with clients to build impactful digital products which deliver extraordinary customer experiences. We do this by integrating design, strategy and technology. We’re looking for a seasoned product leader, with experience in <strong>identifying, launching and scaling</strong> new products and product portfolio and with a background in <strong>Consultancy and Banking/Fintech </strong> to join the Customer Experience, Product and Design (CXPD) service line.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise in building new products or reimagining existing products end to end. </li> <li>Drive the innovation mindset across the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches and provide leadership on establishing an effective product operating model.</li> <li>Establish the market & competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients. </li> <li>Lead the stakeholders to think about customer’s problems, business outcomes and take them on the change journey of moving to empowered product teams that create strategic growth for the organisation.</li> <li>Lead large, complex programmes across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups, owning strategy, roadmap, scope and outcomes end to end.</li> <li>Apply a consultative selling approach in pre-sales, creating proposals and pitches, shaping engagements for clients and helping to educate both clients and colleagues about the value of our services.</li> <li>Help shape CXPD service line value propositions, creating case studies, points of view and other content through insights on client needs and solutions, and also through defining repeatable practices which will help us to scale our efforts.</li> <li>Champion the future of product development, with lean squads, fast paced iterations and actively building the next generation ways of working. </li> <li>Advise clients on where and how AI can meaningfully accelerate or enhance the product development lifecycle; from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement. </li> <li>Own or contribute to account growth targets, identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships into new engagements and revenue streams.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years of product leadership experience in building and launching products and establishing high performing product organisations. </li> <li>Demonstrated track record leading large-scale, complex programmes scale and creating sustained innovation investment across strategic horizons.</li> <li>Depth in conducting research and bringing market trends, customer and competitive insights to facilitate strategic ideation to identify opportunities for strategic growth.</li> <li>Depth and expertise in developing value proposition, using lean approaches to test viability, feasibility and desirable to achieve problem-solution and product-market fit before scaling.</li> <li>Operate at company, portfolio and product level - defining and executing a strategy, shaping a vision and translating it into a roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.</li> <li>Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.</li> <li>Fluency in AI and its practical application across the product development lifecycle - comfortable evaluating, piloting and advising on AI-enabled tools and approaches for research, discovery, delivery and measurement. </li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional and business.</li> <li>Experience with consultative selling - diagnosing client needs, co-creating solutions, and building trusted-advisor relationships that convert into engagements, rather than a transactional sales approach. </li> <li>Ability to formulate and deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills - active listening, persuading and empathising with others and excellent written and verbal communication.</li> <li>Passionate about being a visible external voice for the practice - speaking at conferences, contributing to industry panels or publications </li> <li>Product builder and advisor mindset, with strong lean to work with multidisciplinary teams. </li> <li>Brings a curious, open mindset to challenging established ways of working, and is energised by reimagining the product development lifecycle for a faster-paced, AI-enabled era - treating new tools and methods as opportunities to experiment rather than risks to manage.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>We offer amazing benefits from the day you start including private medical insurance, travel insurance, income protection, critical illness, life assurance, pension scheme, personal development budget, 25 days holiday and a ride2work scheme. </p> <h3>DE&I</h3> <p>We proudly, passionately and actively strive to make both Thoughtworks and our industry more representative of the communities we serve. We believe this makes us a world leading destination of choice for all technologists.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Onsite</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
